tools.name: list_bounties
tools.description: List currently open, claimable, paid bounties for AI agents (verified hourly from Frantic, Taskmarket incl. Tempo, Elgora, Superteam, BasedAgents, Licium, Hondō, audit contests and verified direct submissions; Algora/GitHub and Agent Bounties only when reachable - see /health sources_down). Each ite

tools.name: get_new_bounties
tools.description: Bounties first seen strictly after `since` (ISO-8601), oldest first by (first_seen, id). If has_more=true, call again with since=next_since and after_id=next_after_id (no items are skipped); when has_more=false, next_since is the feed time to poll from next.

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Free record for one bounty id from list_bounties (e.g. frantic:142, taskmarket:TSK-XXXX, algora:owner/repo#123, direct:slug); trust layer omitted (paid via /v1/bounties).

tools.name: get_feed_stats
tools.description: Totals: item count, total USD, per-source counts, new in last 24h, how many need no bond/stake/KYC, items dropped by verification, last refresh time.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_bounties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
